name: TensorPM v1.40.2
body:
# Changelog - v1.40.2

This update stops saving a project from producing sync conflicts, makes the sync panel readable,
and fixes a set of problems in documents (Artifact Mode).

## 🔄 Synchronization

- Saving a project no longer deletes its effort, budget, time, dependency and assignment entries
  on the server, and no longer raises "deleted while you were editing it" for each of them.
  Entries this device had already sent that way are restored automatically, including those
  removed with "Keep deleted", as long as nobody changed them since.
- Conflicts left over from the switch to the new sync protocol, where your device and the server
  hold the same content, are resolved automatically.
- Conflicts are named after the task or person they belong to ("Effort: Pour foundation") instead
  of an internal id, and several at once are announced in one notice instead of one each.
- The sync panel counts conflicts as conflicts, and says when they are in another workspace
  instead of showing "no open conflicts".
- Resolving a conflict takes effect visibly: the entry leaves the list with a confirmation,
  "Restore all" handles every deleted entry at once, and "Keep deleted" asks once more.

## 📄 Documents

- The document chat is kept after handing a project conversation over to a document; chats an
  earlier version had set aside come back.
- Pictures can be inserted from the toolbar, by pasting or by dropping them onto the page.
- Exported documents no longer appear in the Distiller as new signals.
- Questions the document agent asks the project agent no longer appear in the project chat.
- Links in documents open with Cmd/Ctrl+click; only web, mail and phone links are accepted.
- Ctrl+Y redoes, as on Windows and Linux.
- The header says "not saved" while the document cannot be written to disk.
- The agent can no longer remove table rows by accident, replace a header or footer it has not
  read, place a text box where the Word export cannot follow, or change a very large number of
  matches without confirming the count.
- "Retry" after an interrupted agent turn continues from what was already saved instead of
  repeating it.

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.40.2
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-27
- **Previous Version**: 1.40.1
- **Type**: Patch Release
